fields.title: 📖 Zayd ibn ʿAmr: Seeking the religion of Ibrāhīm
fields.body:
🖋️ **Zayd ibn ʿAmr ibn Nufayl** sought the true religion and asked about the Ḥanīfiyyah.

It was explained to him that the Ḥanīfiyyah is the religion of Ibrāhīm: neither Judaism nor Christianity, but **to worship Allah alone**. Thereupon Zayd said in meaning:

***“O Allah, I testify that I am upon the religion of Ibrāhīm.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This report shows Zayd’s disavowal of the existing distorted paths and his return to the Tawḥīd of Ibrāhīm. The correct formulation here is not a direct quotation, “the people are on the wrong path,” but his clear search for the Ḥanīfiyyah and his binding himself to it.

immutable.source: 📝 Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb Manāqib al-Anṣār, Bāb Ḥadīth Zayd ibn ʿAmr ibn Nufayl, Ḥadīth Nr. 3827.
